app.name: Seam
app.tagline: A Git client for staging, diffs and conflicts.

merge.label: Merge
merge.title: Merge a branch into the current one

sync.pullDone: Everything is up to date with the upstream.
sync.pullFailed: Git could not update the branch.

status.fileHunks_one: {{count}} hunk in this file: {{staged}} staged, {{unstaged}} unstaged
status.fileHunks_other: {{count}} hunks in this file: {{staged}} staged, {{unstaged}} unstaged

workarea.selectFile: Select a file to see its diff.

history.title: Commit history
history.empty: This repository has no commits yet.
history.filesEmpty: This commit does not change any file.
history.selectFile: Select a changed file to see its diff.

checkout.title: Check out this commit?
checkout.past: This commit is older than the current HEAD. Checking it out detaches HEAD and moves the working tree back to that revision. The newer commits stay on {{branch}}; commits you make here belong to no branch unless you create one, and are only reachable from the reflog.
checkout.other: This commit is not the current HEAD. Checking it out leaves HEAD detached at {{id}} and switches the working tree to that revision. Commits you make here belong to no branch unless you create one, and are only reachable from the reflog.
checkout.branch: HEAD will stay attached to branch {{branch}} and the working tree will switch to its tip.
checkout.remote: Seam fetches the remote and checks out the local branch {{branch}} that tracks it.
checkout.dirty: There are uncommitted changes. Git may refuse the checkout if they would be overwritten; otherwise they follow you into the checked-out revision.
checkout.operation: A {{operation}} is in progress. Finish or abort it before checking out a commit.
checkout.alreadyHere: You are already at this commit.
checkout.failed: Git could not check out this commit.
checkout.hint: Double-click to check out this commit.

settings.title: Settings
settings.signoffHint: Add Signed-off-by trailer to commits by default
settings.hooksHint: Run pre-commit and commit-msg hooks by default

changes.title: Current Changes
changes.empty: Open a repository to see its staged, unstaged and untracked changes.

clone.title: Clone repository
clone.explain: Git copies a repository from a URL into a new folder named after it.
clone.targetUnknown: Enter a URL and choose a parent folder to see the new folder.
clone.required: Enter a repository URL and choose a parent folder.

conflicts.title: Merge conflicts

help.unresolved: {{name}}: {{kind}}. Resolve manually opens the three-pane editor.
help.deletion: {{name}}: {{kind}}. Keep file or delete file settles it without an editor.
help.binary: {{name}}: {{kind}}. Choose the whole file from one side.
help.resolved: {{name}}: resolved. Show result opens the diff, and the menu can undo the resolution.

conflicts.overwriteExplain: “{{path}}” changed since the conflict was read. Accepting this side overwrites it.
conflicts.abortExplain_one: {{count}} resolved file will be lost. The repository goes back to how it was before the operation started.
conflicts.abortExplain_other: {{count}} resolved files will be lost. The repository goes back to how it was before the operation started.
conflicts.skipExplain: The commit that stopped here is left out of the operation.
conflicts.stopped: {{operation}} stopped on another commit. The list has been reloaded.
conflicts.outputHint: Git stopped before finishing. Its output is below; the conflicts and resolutions are still in place.
conflicts.reviewMergeMessage: Review the merge message and finish the commit.

merge.title: Merge a branch
merge.detached: HEAD is detached. Check out a branch before merging.
merge.squash: Squash the changes into the working tree
merge.messagePlaceholder: Leave empty to use Git's message
merge.operation: A {{operation}} is already in progress. Finish or abort it first.
merge.dirty: Commit or stash your changes before merging.
merge.noBranches: There is no other branch to merge in.
merge.conflicts_one: The merge stopped on {{count}} conflicted file.
merge.conflicts_other: The merge stopped on {{count}} conflicted files.
merge.failed: Git could not merge the branch. Its output is below.
merge.binary: This file is binary. The editor cannot merge it; pick a side in the conflicts list.
merge.readOnlyFile: This file has no two sides to merge, so the editor can only show it.
merge.large: This file is large, so inline highlighting and ribbons are reduced.
merge.discardBody: The result in the centre pane will be lost.

commit.amendPublished: This commit is already published; amending it will need a force push.
commit.timedOut: The commit was still running after five minutes and was stopped.
commit.help: Commit uses staged changes only. Disabled while nothing is staged.
commit.helpMerge: This commits the merge with the message above, once every conflict is resolved.

push.title: Push
push.setUpstream: This branch has no upstream yet; pushing sets one.
push.detached: HEAD is detached, so there is no branch to push. Check out a branch first.
push.noRemotes: This repository has no remote. Add one in a terminal before pushing.
push.timedOut: The push was still running after five minutes and was stopped.
push.updateFailed: Git could not update the branch. Its output is below.
push.authFailed: Git could not authenticate. Seam does not ask for or store passwords: configure the Git credential helper or the SSH agent and try again.

rejected.title: The push was rejected
rejected.nonFastForward: The remote has commits that are not here. Update the branch, then push again.
rejected.remoteRejected: The server refused the push. Its message is below.
rejected.tagExists: That tag already exists on the remote, and Seam will not overwrite it.
rejected.staleInfo: The remote changed since the dialog read it. Fetch again before forcing.
rejected.other: Git refused the push. Its output is below.

push.rebasePublished: This branch already has published commits, so only a merge is offered.
push.forceExplain: Replaces the remote branch only if it still points at {{id}}.
push.conflicts: Resolve the conflicts; Seam reopens the push dialog when you finish.

identity.title: Set your identity
identity.explain: Git signs every commit with a name and an address, and Seam found neither. They are kept in Git's configuration, not in Seam.
identity.name: Name
identity.required: A name and an address are needed to commit.

diff.binary: This is a binary file: {{from}} bytes against {{to}} bytes.
diff.large: This file is large, so inline highlighting is off and the diff is read line by line.

three.title: Stage changes line by line
three.head: HEAD
three.statsStaged_one: Index differs from HEAD by {{count}} line.
three.statsStaged_other: Index differs from HEAD by {{count}} lines.
three.statsWorktree_one: Working copy differs from the index by {{count}} line.
three.statsWorktree_other: Working copy differs from the index by {{count}} lines.
three.helpStageBody: The arrow between the index and the working copy takes that line into the index. One line, one hunk, or the whole file, your choice.
three.helpUnstageBody: The arrow between HEAD and the index puts the HEAD version of that line back, so it drops out of the next commit.
three.helpEditBody: The centre pane is a normal editor. Type in it to stage something finer, such as one word of a line. Its text is exactly what Git stores.
three.status: Staged lines get a "staged" label. Lines still to stage keep an arrow.
three.binary: This file is binary, so it cannot be prepared by line.
three.takeWorktree: Take this line from the working copy
three.takeWorktreeHunk: Take this change from the working copy

eol.title: Line endings
eol.explain: These staged files carry CRLF line endings into the repository, and no attribute says otherwise. Committing them stores CRLF in the index, which mixes endings with the files that already use LF.
eol.disable: Do not warn me about CRLF again

branch.title: Branches
branch.explain: Create a branch from HEAD, a branch or a tag. Rename or delete one without leaving Seam.
branch.name: Branch name
branch.head: Current HEAD
branch.nameRequired: Give the new branch a name.
branch.deleteCurrent: Check out another branch before deleting this one.
branch.deleteExplain: Git deletes a branch only when its commits are already merged. Forcing the delete throws the unmerged commits away.
branch.force: Delete even if its commits are not merged

gitflow.title: GitFlow
gitflow.initExplain: Choose the two long-lived branches and the prefixes of the branches Seam creates. GitFlow stores this in the repository's local configuration.
gitflow.operation: A {{operation}} is in progress. Finish or abort it first.
gitflow.dirty: Commit or stash your changes before continuing.
gitflow.name: Branch name

finishExplain.feature: Merges the feature into {{develop}} with a merge commit and deletes it.
finishExplain.release: Merges the release into {{master}}, tags it, merges {{master}} back into {{develop}} and deletes it.
finishExplain.hotfix: Merges the hotfix into {{master}}, tags it, merges {{master}} back into {{develop}} and deletes it.

gitflow.resumeExplain: A finish stopped at "{{step}}". Resolve what stopped it and continue from here.
gitflow.conflicts_one: The finish stopped on {{count}} conflicted file. Resolve it, then continue.
gitflow.conflicts_other: The finish stopped on {{count}} conflicted files. Resolve them, then continue.
gitflow.failed: Git could not finish the branch. Its output is below.

gitGate.missingBody: Seam runs the Git installed on your computer. Install Git 2.30 or newer, then check again.
gitGate.tooOldBody: Seam needs Git 2.30 or newer. Update Git, then check again.
gitGate.reopenHint: If the check still fails, close and reopen Seam so it finds the new installation.

errors.gitNotFound: Git was not found. Install Git 2.30 or newer and reopen Seam.
errors.gitTooOld: The installed Git is too old. Version 2.30 or newer is required.
errors.notARepository: That folder is not a Git repository.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong while reading the repository.
